brainlife.desc: MP2RAGE acquisition (NIfTI): magnitude and phase of both inversions, optional UNI image, with JSON sidecars. Experimental.
brainlife.name: neuro/anat/mp2rage

original.desc: (experimental) tentative data format for MP2RAGE in brainlife. Modeling after https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/99-appendices/11-qmri.html#inputs-are-file-collections
original.readme:
I am not sure how we should import UNI images

There is a bit of information here
> https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/99-appendices/11-qmri.html#unit1-images

But Sophis says there is no inv- for UNI images although BIDS schema requires it..

brainlife.readme:
I am not sure how we should import UNI images

There is a bit of information here
> https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/99-appendices/11-qmri.html#unit1-images

But Sophis says there is no inv- for UNI images although BIDS schema requires it..

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.anat.mp2rage.json
